raw_review_excerpt:
Plan 02 is freeze-ready. The four prior-round focus areas (summary filename, uv-managed Python invocation, target read-only baseline, and script/report behavior) are all resolved in the current artifact. Summary filename `01-02-SUMMARY.md` matches the workflow convention. All `uv run` commands are preceded by `uv sync --group dev`. Task 3 captures target `git status` and `HEAD` before and after the harness run, with acceptance criteria requiring both unchanged and no files created under the target repo. Generation gating is doubly enforced (default-off, explicit flag, temp-only workdir). One minor NOTE: `--print-json` is declared in Task 1's argparse list but has no corresponding behavior test or acceptance criterion. This does not block freeze.

Issues:
- 1. [NOTE] --print-json flag declared but untested
closure_verification: All four prior-round focus items verified resolved against the current artifact. No prior-round claims required downgrade or remained unproven.

issues.title: --print-json flag declared but untested
issues.details: Task 1 action lists --print-json as an argparse argument, but no <behavior> test or acceptance criterion exercises this flag. The flag is low-risk (stdout JSON output) and does not affect the core contract.
issues.suggested_fix: Optionally add a behavior test asserting --print-json writes valid JSON to stdout without saving files. Not required for freeze.

verification_gaps: Task 3 verification block includes `git -C ... status --short --branch` but does not separately list `git rev-parse HEAD` as a verify command; however, the acceptance criteria require the HEAD comparison, so the executor must capture it during action. This is a gap in verify-block completeness but not in acceptance criteria.
evidence_sources: 01-02-PLAN.md (current artifact, full text embedded in prompt)
workflow_compliance: Plan output section specifies `01-02-SUMMARY.md` which matches the workflow convention `{phase}-{plan}-SUMMARY.md`.
Verification commands use `uv sync --group dev` followed by `uv run --group dev` consistently.
Plan declares `depends_on: [01-01]` and `autonomous: true` — correct sequencing metadata.
Frontmatter `requirements` array lists all Phase 1 requirement IDs — supports SUMMARY requirements-completed propagation.
Execution context references execute-plan.md and summary.md template correctly.
technical_reality: pyproject.toml does not currently have a dev dependency group; Plan 01 Task 1 is responsible for creating it — Plan 02 correctly depends on Plan 01.
graphify/status_harness.py and graphify/status_profiles.py do not exist on disk — confirming Plan 01 has not executed and Plan 02's `depends_on` is load-bearing.
scripts/graphify_status_harness.py does not exist yet — this is the primary artifact Plan 02 creates.
uv run --group dev python scripts/... is the correct invocation pattern for running a script with uv dev dependencies.
graphify/__main__.py has no status-harness routing — consistent with D-01 no-public-CLI boundary.
assumptions_to_verify: Plan 01 will create graphify/status_harness.py with the exact exports listed in the <interfaces> block (run_status_harness, render_markdown_summary, write_reports, and generation gating).
Plan 01 will create graphify/status_profiles.py with get_profile, TargetProfile, and PROFILES exports.
Plan 01 will add a [dependency-groups] dev = ['pytest>=8'] section to pyproject.toml and sync uv.lock.
The Second Brain target repo at /Users/mase/Codebase/Personal-Projects/my-second-brain-build will be accessible and have a graphify-out/ directory when Task 3 runs.
verification_sufficiency: Task 1 and 2 verify commands run both test_status_harness.py and test_status_harness_script.py — sufficient for script-level coverage.
Task 3 verify commands include the actual harness run plus git status check — sufficient for read-only proof.
Acceptance criteria are testable and specific across all three tasks.
Generation gating is verified both by test absence in default mode and by explicit test presence in gated mode.
downstream_risks: If Plan 01 changes the generation-check API shape (e.g., separate function vs. keyword argument), Plan 02 Task 1's argparse wiring may need adjustment — but the plan accounts for this with 'or equivalent' hedging in the interfaces block.
review.freeze_recommendation: Safe to freeze. Carry the remaining WARN/NOTE items as explicit follow-ups or implementation-time checks.
